lines.text: Welcome back, Master. I'll leave the meal preparations and cleaning to you, okay?

Agent work? Sure, I'll do it if you ask me to. I haven't gone rusty
anyway ♥
Being a maid is more boring than I thought. I guess I'm glad you're here, Master.
I'm working hard here, you know... Like checking up on you, or warming up your bed ♥

I'm ready to do anything you ask, Master. You hear that?
A-ny-thing ♥
Master! ... It's nothing. I just felt like calling you ♥
Looks like Master's busy. Time for me to slack off then.
Master, are you busy? In that case... just relax. I'll take care of everything ♥
If you pick me at the Maid Cafe, I'll treat you to a special service just for you, Master.
I was just looking around, checking out the routes. You know, just in case.
*Yawn* Mind if I sleep in your room for a bit, Master?
Hi, Master ♥ I'm Velvet, your maid. Go easy on me, okay?
You're even taking care of a maid like me? That makes me so happy!
At this rate, I'm gonna be stronger than ever!
Do you think you can handle me?
This means a lot, Master! ... Would you be happy if I said that?
I really appreciate this, Master ♥
In return... you get me ♥
You're really making me want you, you know?
If you keep this up, I won't be able to hold back ♥
Master, do you wanna be mine?
How can you expect a maid to do something like this!
Yes, Master ♥
How troublesome... but I'll do it for you, Master!
Target acquired. Shall we get started?
I'll end this quickly ♥
Shall I get warmed up?
Hmph! I don't want to.
Just a sec!
Reloading!
*Sigh* When will this end?
Shall we wrap this up?
Ugh, let's just play ♥
Hahaha! Here comes the finale!
Got one!
Feels like old times.
How lame...
Eeek ♥
